audit_rubric.usefulness_9_10: Essential differentiated workflow with real persistence or reliable server behavior and strong user states.
audit_rubric.usefulness_7_8: High-value page with clear workflow; minor integration, duplication, or state gaps.
audit_rubric.usefulness_5_6: Useful supporting page but partial, narrow, duplicative, or presentation-heavy.
audit_rubric.usefulness_3_4: Low-value prototype, mostly static or simulated; better merged or moved to Secondary Information.
audit_rubric.usefulness_1_2: Broken, misleading, near-empty, unsafe, or obsolete; retire only after owner approval.
